name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-agent
description: Prototype: V3 agent identity + agent config — per-agent profiles (id/name/role/status/publicKey) + ed25519-signed fleet events (own format, node:crypto only) + actor attribution ledger. P4.3 fleet-admin: runtime profile CRUD (updateProfile/disable/enable), admin web page + profile API (/admin, /api/agents on dsh webServer or standalone fleet-agent-admin), and the isEnabled() wake-consult seam. Registers ctx.fleetAgent and injects agent_whoami/agent_sign/agent_verify/agent_audit/agent_update/agent_disable/agent_enable/agent_list tools. Issue #26.
